name: The Autumn Graves (Thu Phần Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: while you hold all three, each curse you lay rings the bell and adds a Resentment mark to the foe. At seven marks the jade seal presses: the foe's highest layer is Sealed Meridian, and they take soul damage scaled by your Darkness. Each press in the same fight needs one more mark.

story: The bell Ân Thanh Linh cast in 1062, the seal of the first grave jade, and the robe of the barred door. The head holds all three. The Pavilion says the set is not hers but the graves', lent to whoever hears them.

name: The Second Copy (Phó Bản)

bonuses.rule: every third soul song you sing falls into the drum's cadence and repeats once at half power. Against a foe carrying one of your curses, the repeat is at full power.

story: The drum and the robe that hides the second copy. The head does not know they make a set, because she does not know what is in the lining.
